title: Telling time
summary: Ask Quelle heure est-il ? Answer with Il est + hour. Add et quart, et demie, or moins le quart. Midi and minuit replace douze heures in many contexts.
full_explanation: Ask Quelle heure est-il ? Answer with Il est + hour. Add et quart, et demie, or moins le quart. Midi and minuit replace douze heures in many contexts.

deepDive.whyItMatters: Ask Quelle heure est-il ? Answer with Il est + hour. Add et quart, et demie, or moins le quart. Midi and minuit replace douze heures in many contexts. This pattern appears constantly in real conversation and in Phase I checkpoints.

sections.heading: How to practice
sections.body: Produce each example without looking, then mix with earlier forms.

sections.heading: Traps
sections.body: Do not translate word-for-word from English every time. Keep French chunks whole. Check gender and articles when a noun is involved.
